description.value:
You already lived the adventuring life once, whether as part of a famous company or an outfit nobody remembers, and you thought you were done with it. You picked up a working knowledge of nearly every skill an adventurer needs to survive, usually the hard way.

The years since haven't been kind to some of those old friendships, and a few of your former contacts might not answer the comm the way they used to — but the instincts from that life never really left, and neither did the itch to use them again.

system.equipment: A grappling hook, one tool with which you are proficient, a memento of an unsuccessful expedition, and a pouch containing 50 credits.
